The collision is settled at verification, where only one account can win.

item.name: Prove an address with your sign-in account

request.name: Prove an address with your sign-in account

description.content: Marks the address verified if — and only if — the token on this request carries it as a verified `email` claim, i.e. your identity provider already ran its own confirmation against that mailbox. This platform sends no message of its own, so the only address you can prove is the one your sign-in account uses: change it at the provider, confirm the mail it sends, sign in again, then call this. Answers 409 when the token proves nothing, proves a different address, or when another account has already proven this one. Verifying your first proven address of a kind also makes it primary, replacing the unproven placeholder an invite left.
